name: Squarespace
summary: Polished templates and a strong editor; the AI builder generates a first draft of the site.

pricing.free_plan: No free plan; a 14-day trial without publishing

capabilities: Template-driven design with a built-in AI site generator
Commerce, scheduling and email campaigns on higher plans
Very strong typography and image handling
limits: A trial site answers HTTP 401 "Private Website" for visitors, so nothing can be measured on a published page without paying.
No free plan, so nothing can be published without paying
The pricing page serves regional prices; the US numbers here come from third-party reports, not the vendor page
Signup is guarded by reCAPTCHA Enterprise, so account creation cannot be automated (checked 06.11.2026)
run_blocker: trial site stays private (HTTP 401) — publishing needs a paid plan (verified 09.11.2026)

custom_domain.detail: A free custom domain for the first year is part of the annual plans

payments.detail: Squarespace Payments, commerce features on the business tiers
